item.title: Inventor of hand-worn cycling indicator thinks new brighter lights will win cyclists round after dim start to crowdfunding campaign — plus some very bling bars and… a speedsuit for gravel?!
item.description: Our weekly tech round-up, including new stuff from Pinarello, Castelli, Vittoria, Strava, Reserve Wheels and more

item.title: Exposure Boost 3
item.description: Physically very well made but electronically not well designed, and it's expensive

item.title: “It has caused chaos”: £1.3m cycle lane dug up for the third time
item.description: Businesses say that the repeated roadworks on the Manchester cycle path is “a bit of a nightmare” and are causing a drop in trade

item.title: BMC Roadmachine 01 Three
item.description: Endurance bike geometry, race machine performance and spirit – BMC has achieved an impressive balance

item.title: “How to go from clean licence to six points in under a minute”: Cyclist tells drivers to put their phone away when driving, after motorist ordered to pay £1,727 because of rider’s camera footage + more on the live blog
item.description: Your Winter Olympics distractions are over so feel free to join Dan Alexander in diving back in to the live blog for all your cycling-related procrastination needs this Monday

item.title: Rapha Men’s Core Rain Jacket
item.description: The best has just got better: Rapha's upgrades make this a must-have for wet days.

item.title: “A very sad moment”: Two killed and six injured as driver of race vehicle veers off road into crowd at Tour of Rwanda
item.description: “This accident reminds us of the importance of road safety and always remain vigilant, whether driving or cheering on the riders along the race,” Rwanda’s sports minister said

item.title: “Watch out for those doors, they’re quite sturdy”: World champion breaks hip after “getting smoked by car door” in training, ruling him out of Cape Epic mountain bike race
item.description: Despite racing just days after being ‘doored’ by a driver, Keegan Swenson admitted he was still “struggling to walk”, scans later revealing that the American off-road specialist had fractured his iliac crest

item.title: Worrying start to 2026 for Giant as bike brand’s revenue slumps by 22% in January
item.description: Giant’s weak opening month of the year follows a turbulent time for the Taiwanese manufacturer, which was the subject of a prolonged embargo by the US government over forced labour allegations

item.title: Halfords freezes bike prices for 2026: the Carrera Vanquish road bike is still under £500 and 12-speed carbon stays comfortably under £2k
item.description: Halfords has released its 2026 cycling range, and while there are few major updates, many bikes and accessories return at the same prices
